verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for a SaaS meeting recorder like Fathom, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing on choosing a storage region or data residency. SSO/SCIM, API, and webhook material is about other capabilities and does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
